definitions.explanation: Work or duties performed as part of a government or public position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公務|こうむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}している→出張：01094_shucchou⟧。
examples.english: The minister is on a business trip for official duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a civil servant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公務|こうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなされている→こなす：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The members of the Imperial family carry out many official duties.

notes:
{公務|こうむ} refers to official or public duties, typically performed by government employees or public figures.

Common compounds:
- {公務員|こうむいん} (civil servant, public employee)
- {公務|こうむ}{執行|しっこう} (execution of official duties)
- {公務|こうむ}{出張|しゅっちょう} (official business trip)

Related words:
- {私用|しよう} (private business) - opposite of {公務|こうむ}
- {職務|しょくむ} (job duties) - general work duties
- {任務|にんむ} (mission, assignment)
